This must be a record, as Apple is now rolling out the sixth round of developer and public release candidate versions for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8. Here are the details.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8 sixth release candidates now available

If you thought the fifth release candidate of macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 would be the last before the official update, it looks like Apple has another version up its sleeve.

The company is now pushing out the sixth release candidate for these two operating systems, and given the timing, it is expected to include important security patches. Apple recently released iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 26.5.2, which included fixes originally planned for the 26.6 release, issued early due to risks posed by new artificial intelligence tools.

Apple has not disclosed what updates are included in these systems, only providing the default release notes stating "contains important security patches, recommended for all users." Today's release candidate version numbers are as follows:

Today's release candidate version numbers are as follows:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8: 23J619
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8: 24G822
